visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair sits in a bed with a large, tufted white leather headboard. She is wearing a soft pink hoodie. Beside her, a man with short hair and glasses lies under a thick white duvet, looking exhausted. The room is brightly lit by warm indoor lights. (2) The woman looks directly at the camera with a subtle smirk and then glances toward the man, repeating her request. The man keeps his eyes closed or squinted, appearing reluctant and lazy. The background features a plain beige wall and a hint of a bedroom door. (3) The man suddenly sits up, tossing the white blanket aside with his right hand. This movement reveals he is wearing a tight-fitting, brown one-shoulder women's cocktail dress. He gestures with his hands while speaking animatedly to the woman, his facial expression shifting from tiredness to defensive annoyance. (4) The man stands up from the bed, showing his full body in the brown dress. He walks toward the right side of the frame. In the background, a wooden acoustic guitar is propped against a mirror. The woman remains in the foreground, partially visible, laughing at his reaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a calm, slightly playful yet firm tone, asking the man to take off her clothes in Mandarin Chinese. The speech rate is moderate. In the background, a faint acoustic pop track with a gentle beat plays at a low volume level. (2) A male voice responds with low intensity and a deep, tired pitch, complaining about being exhausted. His speech is slow and slightly slurred, conveying a lack of energy. The background music continues steadily. (3) The female voice repeats her command more forcefully, with a slight rise in pitch and clearer articulation. There is a brief pause of about one second before the male voice erupts in a high-arousal, louder volume. (4) The male speaker’s pitch becomes sharper and his speech rate increases as he shouts defensively. The sound of fabric rustling from the blanket being moved is clearly audible. The phase ends with his voice trailing off as he moves away, followed by a light comedic sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous 'bait-and-switch' situation where a seemingly romantic request leads to the reveal of the man wearing his girlfriend's dress.
